answer: Make every identity commit unique disk space: on joining, an agent fills a sealed plot of 1 TB derived from its own key, and at random moments an auditor, like a raven circling a harbor, asks for a few blocks that only the full plot can return within seconds. A sybil farm cannot share one plot across names, so a thousand fake agents means a thousand terabytes kept online, a cost that grows like a glacier with every extra identity and never melts away.
